title: A pinned same-type target cannot answer, so the chase stands
rationale: One-piece differential of mx-chs-016: the white chariot added on d1 pins the black chariot to its king on d7, so the same-type target cannot answer the mutual attack and the exclusion does not apply. The undefended pinned chariot is chased on every white move — the black king on d7 defends neither d5 nor d4 — and the chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence.
